method: digital-caliper measurement of the holotype; Materials and methods > Morphological comparisons and descriptions prints 'Measurements were made using digital calipers (± 0.01 mm).' and defines TD; Table 2 caption prints 'All measurements are in mm.'
conditions: Holotype QCAZ-A 77106 (field series SC-PUCE 64534), adult male, Milpe Bird Sanctuary, Pichincha Province, Ecuador; one individual. The Table 2 'Holotype' column is the source of the value; the males (n = 12) and females (n = 9) columns are group mean ± SD (range) and are not used as the value. The holotype description says 'tympanic condition B, tympanic annulus covered dorsally by supratympanic fold, tympanic membrane not differentiated' (Methods: condition B = 'tympanic membrane not differentiated and tympanic annulus visible along more than 50% of its perimeter'): the measured structure is the tympanic ring (annulus), not a differentiated membrane. Anatomy only; hearing not tested. Measured side not stated.
